title: When means are short
explanation: The line connects limited means with the distress of being unable to meet needs. Its compact rhyme can express sympathy for someone trying to make a small sum cover many demands. It need not be read as an accusation of greed or a judgement about character.
meaning_odia: ଟଙ୍କା ଅଳ୍ପ ଥିଲେ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ କାମ କିପରି ହେବ, ସେହି ଚିନ୍ତା ମନକୁ ଅସ୍ଥିର କରିପାରେ। ଧନର ଅଭାବ ଓ ମନର ବିକଳତାକୁ ଛୋଟ କଥାଟି ଏକାଠି ରଖିଛି। ଏହାକୁ ଲୋଭର ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଅପେକ୍ଷା ଅପୂରଣ ଆବଶ୍ୟକତାର ଦୁଃଖ ଭାବେ ବୁଝିବା ଏଠାରେ ଅଧିକ ସଂଗତ।
usage_example: A family is weighing school expenses against a repair bill; someone uses the line to acknowledge the pressure. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source adds an explanation about being unable to obtain necessities. That explanatory parenthesis is kept outside the saying itself.
